<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>

      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity=".72"/>

    </filter>
  </defs>

  <text x="20" y="29" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">9:41</text>

  <!-- app header -->

  </g>

  <rect x="16" y="115" width="358" height="533" rx="22" fill="#000000" opacity=".12"/>

    <rect x="16" y="111" width="358" height="533" rx="22" fill="#D0CECD"/>
  </g>

  <rect x="16" y="111" width="358" height="533" rx="22" fill="#D9D9D9"/>

    <tspan x="37" dy="30" font-size="15" font-weight="500">Creative soul, weekend explorer,</tspan>
    <tspan x="37" dy="21" font-size="15" font-weight="500">and always up for good coffee.</tspan>
